body: Founder: 'for damage we want to make it match up.' gameEntityHit's own Entity() used to return a no-op stub (nopEntity) even after real hit detection landed -- a hit was detected but never actually hurt anyone. New realEntity applies real damage to the hit client's own hpState, mirroring PacketWSCast's own already-real damage application exactly (same TakeDamage call, same defensive fallback hpState). Mutates the same clients map the main loop owns (Go maps are reference types), no separate write-back needed. 6 new tests. go build/go vet/go test ./... clean. Live-verified: real gfd-server-go.service rebuilt, redeployed, confirmed stable. Per founder direction mid-session: this closes out the SHANKPIT-hitscan combat thread for now -- priority shifts to unifying combat with Battlegrounds (WoW/FFXI/LoL-shaped, tab-target/ability-kit) as the real MMO foundation, with real-time shooter mechanics reconsidered later on top of that, not before it. GoblinFoxDragon 7629477.
title: Real damage on hitscan hit -- closes SHANKPIT-hitscan thread for now
